name: AIGeneratedDashboard
description: AIGeneratedDashboard is a page-level pattern that renders the AI’s response to a strategic prompt as a multi-zone living dashboard rather than a single chat message. The starter scenario — Cardiology Expansion Q2 — demonstrates how the AI proposes a Boston cluster re-alignment, surfaces concurrent scenarios (Immunology Launch Readiness, Newark Territory Health Review), shows impact and risk telemetry, and overlays the proposal on a territory map. Every zone carries accountability: confidence, impact, agent attribution, rationale, sources, and an explicit Draft / Submit governance handoff. The component is designed to inhabit the right pane of AICommandCenterSplitView and also to stand alone as a saved artifact.
intent: The AI-generated workspace. Scenarios, impact, and map overlays compose into a single governed output the operator can shape, approve, and submit.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

props.hint: Output-type label shown next to the title (e.g. Alignment Map, Scenario Plan).

props.name: confidence
props.hint: Confidence percentage displayed in the header trust pair.

props.name: impactScore
props.hint: Impact percentage displayed in the header trust pair.

props.name: showHeader
props.hint: Whether to render the dashboard header. Set false when embedded.

props.name: criticalMode
props.hint: Surfaces signal-orange highlights on impact tiles and escalation thresholds.

props.name: mapFocused
props.hint: Expands the map module to full width and condenses other modules to a side rail.

props.name: onSubmit
props.hint: Fires when the Submit button is pressed.

props.name: onToggleDraft
props.hint: Fires when the Draft Mode toggle is flipped.

props.name: onViewRationale
props.hint: Fires when any “View rationale” link is activated.

props.name: onViewSources

props.name: onPromptSelect
